text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Haa... The breeze feels lovely. Thank you 
for inviting me out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking that I wanted to make 
a statement of resolve in order to get 
fired up again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. To me, a shrine is a place to show my 
resolve.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My dream is not something merely to wish 
for, but one that must be fulfilled.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Without further ado, let's hear your 
declaration of inten—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
One of the Twelve Umamusume Deities! The 
Eternal Golgol God has desceeeended!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Gold Ship-san. Are you engaging 
in your eccentricities yet again...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ho, ho, ho~. Now then, lost soul, what is 
it that you wish of me~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Kuh, you're not even listening, are you... 
How infuriating. In that case, I will 
simply focus on declaring my resolve.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Focus, stay focused... Me...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Grrr... grrrhhhh~~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I was able to focus perfectly! Too 
bad for you, Gold Ship-san?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yo! How're things on your end, 
Poppo-maru?! Has it been like, five 
light-years?

text_block_list.name: Poppomaru
text_block_list.text: (Coo-coo-roo! Coo-coo!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wait... You're not listening to me AGAIN!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the Crow Empire's forces remain 
formidable. The day I draw the legendary 
holy sword draws near...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Guh...! I managed to focus, I really 
did...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I feel so unsettled about this...!

...At any rate, she managed to make a firm 
declaration of her resolve.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "Gol-Gol Fire Arrow!! Whoaaaaaaa~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, honestly! I cannot possibly 
concentrate in this situation!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, that! What kind of god is that 
even supposed to be!!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What're you babbling about, a "god"? 
Just how obsessed with me are you?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Fine, fine, I'll play with you! Being so 
popular sure is tough~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Haaahhh~~!?

"...Putting off the declaration of resolve 
for another time, I took Mejiro McQueen 
back with me."
